snippets.output: The study suggests that taking losartan and indapamide together in the night may have advantages over taking them at separate times.

The study on the new formulation of losartan, Losartan Cronos, suggests that this formulation maintains its antihypertensive effect for 24 hours, regardless of the administration time. Losartan Cronos is a bilayer tablet containing 50 mg of Losartan immediate release (IR) and 50 mg extended release (ER).

Taking two losartan pills at once or at separate times is not recommended without consulting a healthcare professional. Losartan should be taken as directed by the healthcare provider, and the timing of administration may vary depending on the individual patient's needs and medical conditions.

According to the study by Huangfu et al., the administration time of losartan and indapamide can affect blood pressure reduction and the rate of nighttime blood pressure decline.
The pharmacokinetics of losartan can be affected by various factors, including food intake and the presence of other medications.

A study on the bioequivalence of two losartan tablets in fasting conditions suggests that losartan can be taken with or without food, although the bioavailability of losartan may be affected by the presence of food.
